---

## What Was Built

**Before defining phases, I mapped the file structure** — 30+ files across six responsibility areas, each with a single clear job. Here's the shape of the plan:

---

### File Structure Areas
| Area | Files |
|---|---|
| Platform Entry Point | `main.dart`, `firebase_options.dart` |
| Package Compatibility Layer | 12 files — 4 conditional-import facades (permission, notifications, geolocation, camera), each with a mobile impl + a web stub |
| Feature Guards | `video_call_screen.dart`, `premium_screen.dart` — `kIsWeb` inline guards |
| Router & Shell | `app_router.dart`, `core_pwa_home_screen.dart`, new `not_found_screen.dart`, `offline_banner.dart` |
| PWA Install CTA | `web_install_manager.dart` (dart:js interop), `install_banner.dart` |
| Responsive Layouts | `discover_screen.dart`, `chat_list_screen.dart`, `chat_thread_screen.dart`, dialog utility |
| PWA Shell | `web/manifest.json`, `web/index.html`, 4 icon files |
| Firebase Hosting | `firebase.json` |

---

### 5 Phases, Each Producing Testable Software

| Phase | Milestone | Dep |
|---|---|---|
| 1. Build Unblocked | `flutter build web` exits 0; Chrome opens app shell | None |
| 2. Core User Flows | Full sign-up → swipe → chat flow in Chrome | Phase 1 |
| 3. PWA Shell | Lighthouse PWA >= 90; app installs from browser | Phase 2 |
| 4. Responsive Layouts | QA pass at 375/768/1024 px; tablet layouts verified | Phase 2 |
| 5. Polish & Deploy | Live on Firebase Hosting; cross-browser QA passed | All |

**The critical path runs through Phase 1** — nothing can be tested until the build compiles cleanly. **Phases 3 and 4 can run in parallel** after Phase 2 lands (zero file overlap between them).

**Seven open questions** are flagged with their exact blocking phase — the most urgent being Firebase web config values (blocks Phase 1, Step 2) and Firestore Security Rules audit (blocks all of Phase 2).
